title: George and the Dinosaur Under the Blanket

learning.summary_zh: George 睡著後，Mike 輕拍他的臉頰叫醒他，房間開始變了；他們聽見棉被下的聲響，幫迷路的小恐龍 Nibble 找巢；早晨棉被上留下一片蕨葉。
focus_en: Bedtime words: blanket, whisper, glow, adventure
Observation: footprint, tiny footprints, I can see
Key phrases: Hold my hand. Stay close to me. One step at a time. We can be brave together.
tutor_prompts_zh: 問：棉被下面的 thump 是什麼？（小恐龍 Nibble，不是怪獸）
問：Mike 很怕的時候，George 說了什麼？（Hold my hand / We can be brave together）
問：他們怎麼找到 nest？（腳印 + 小夜燈 + Mike 幫忙看）
問：醒來後留下什麼證據？（一片小蕨葉，像 Nibble 的巢）

pages.alt: Daddy reads a bedtime story while George holds Mike

lines.text: It was late, and George was tucked under his warm blanket in the big bed.
Daddy sat beside him and read one last story from a picture book.
Just one more chapter, George. Then it is time to sleep.
Can Mike listen too? He likes adventures.

pages.alt: George sleeps hugging Mike with only the little lamp glowing

lines.text: When the story ended, Daddy kissed George good night and switched off the main light.
Only the little lamp was left, glowing softly beside the bed.
George lay on his side, hugging Mike under the warm blanket, and soon he was fast asleep.

pages.alt: George sleeps hugging Mike while Mike gently pats his cheek to wake him

lines.text: George was fast asleep, hugging Mike in the quiet room.
Then Mike gently patted George's cheek with his soft little hand.
George, wake up. I heard a strange sound.

pages.alt: George sits up as something thumps under the cream blanket

lines.text: George sat up fast. Something under the blanket went thump, thump, thump.
George, look! The blanket is moving!
What is that? I am a little scared too.
Let us count to three and peek. One... two... three!

pages.alt: The blanket becomes a soft green hill with footprints leading under a fold

lines.text: George pulled back the blanket — and it grew into a soft green hill!
The grey curtains stood tall around the hill, like silver trees.
George, look! Tiny footprints! Something small walked up the hill.
Let us follow them. Stay close to me, Mike.

pages.alt: George lifts a fold in the green blanket hill while Mike stays close

lines.text: The tiny footprints stopped at a soft fold in the hill.
Something is hiding in there. I can hear it move!
Let us whisper, so we do not scare it. I will look first.

pages.alt: A tiny dinosaur peeks out from behind the blanket

lines.text: George lifted the fold, and a tiny dinosaur peeked out!
A monster! George, hide!
Peep... peep...
Mike, look. It is a baby dinosaur, and he is shaking. He is more scared than us.

pages.alt: Nibble tells George she cannot find her nest

lines.text: Peep! My name is Nibble, and I am lost. I cannot find my nest.
Do not cry, little one. We will help you find it.
My nest is warm and soft. It smells like green ferns.

pages.alt: George holds the chick lamp at the curtain forest edge; Mike points at tiny glowing footprints leading into the grey curtain trees

lines.text: Look! More footprints! They go this way, into the curtain forest.
George picked up the little lamp, and its warm glow lit up the footprints.
One step at a time. We will go together.

pages.alt: George, Mike and Nibble walk through the darker curtain forest

lines.text: In the curtain forest, the path grew darker, and Mike began to tremble.
I do not like the dark. What if I get lost too?
Hold my hand. The lamp is with us, and we can be brave together.

pages.alt: Nibble curls up in a small nest of green ferns in the curtain forest

lines.text: Behind the last curtain, they found a little nest of soft green ferns.
My nest! My nest! Peep, peep!
You are home now, Nibble. Sleep well.
We did it! We really found it!

pages.alt: George wakes beside Mike and finds a tiny fern leaf on the blanket

lines.text: In the morning, George woke beside Mike and found a tiny green fern leaf on the blanket.
Mike, look! Where did this leaf come from? It was not here last night.
George held the fern leaf up to the light, but neither of them could explain it.

quiz.q: What sound did George hear under the blanket?
What does Mike do to wake George?
What does George say about the little dinosaur?
options: He is more scared than us

quiz.q: What helps them find the way to the nest?
What does George say when Mike is afraid in the dark?
options: Shout as loud as you can

quiz.q: What is left on the blanket in the morning?
Who reads with George before sleep?
What does Mike say when they find the nest?
options: We did it! We really found it!
